law: The adjudication ledger for the O.9.3 column dossier. It lives HERE and not in docs/column-dossier.json because that artifact is regenerated from scratch on every run -- a decision written into it would be erased by the next build, and on 2026-07-27 two stale builds silently reverted that artifact, so a hand adjudication lost that way would have been unrecoverable and invisible. An ADJUDICATION BEATS A BULK RULE: the rules are triage, a human looking at the column and its evidence is the authority.
key_format: source|table_key|column -- exactly the dossier's row_key(). table_key is '*' for WIDE sources, the composite discriminator value for MULTI_TABLE, 'stat_name' or 'physical' for LONG. For nflcom_player_logs it is 'caption|layout'.

vocabulary.MAPPED_TO_CANONICAL: maps to an existing canonical stat; `canonical` must name it
vocabulary.NEW_SUPERTABLE_COLUMN_CANDIDATE: real material the supertable does not carry; routes through the census + demand join (24.4), never ad-hoc
vocabulary.EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON: carries no stat content, argued case by case rather than by rule
vocabulary.DUPLICATE_OF: the same material as another dossier row; `canonical` must name it

notes: `evidence` is mandatory and is checked by a zero-gate. An adjudication without evidence is an opinion, and this programme has already paid for accepting one (the 2026-07-26 handoff's ABANDONED-no-local-source claim, which the ledger beneath it contradicted).

The two COLUMN_DICTIONARY artifacts are the primary evidence source where they exist: StatsCrew and PFA both publish each column's full name in a title attribute (`tds` is 'PassingTouchdowns' while `td` is 'Touchdown Percentage'). Cite them rather than re-deriving a meaning by inspection.
For nflcom, docs/nflcom-column-semantics.json carries the O.9.0 per-layout semantics, receipted 9/9 by self-contained derived-column identities.
A decision whose key the dossier no longer produces becomes ORPHANED and is counted, never silently dropped -- dropping it would re-open an adjudicated row with nobody noticing.
EMPTY IS THE HONEST STARTING STATE: 10,273 rows are open and none has been adjudicated yet.

decisions.reason: WITHDRAWN FROM EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON. It was excluded as 'a derived ratio whose operands are both published in the same header, so the row carries no material they do not'. That reasoning answers whether the column is REDUNDANT AS A MAPPING and not whether the STATISTIC is one we carry -- and v26 has no net punting average at all. Joe, twice: 'avg is just another way to witness on the season and career levels and also might expose some rate statistics we want.' Net average is the modern evaluative punting number. Measured against PFR punt_net_yds_per_punt at 65.37% on single-team seasons, which is too low to promote and too high to dismiss -- its operand net_yds agrees 95.62% on the same join, so the numerator is sound and the two publishers differ on the rate's definition (likely the touchback penalty).

The prior exclusion ('the v26 subject is player-WEEK grain and has no such column by construction') was false -- player_nfl_season carries games_started over 112,632 rows, 1920-2025. Hand MapSpec with agg='value' (v26 side reads the stored season value) and witness_agg='sum' (the career page is PER-TEAM; a traded player's rows must be summed). Measured PER TABLE rather than shared, because g/gs agree across career tables on only 97.43% of player-seasons.

decisions.reason: THE JOIN AXIS CANNOT WITNESS ITSELF. This was MAPPED_TO_CANONICAL -> `year` and read as 'mapped but unwired' on every career table. A spec would not fix that: every witness comparison in this programme is built as `FROM w JOIN v USING (pfr_id, yr)` where `yr` IS TRY_CAST(s.season AS INT) -- so measuring source.season against v26.year is circular, would report ~100%, and would test nothing. The mapping is TRUE (the site's `season` is our `year`); it simply carries no STAT content, locating the row in time exactly as nflcom_slug locates it in identity. Filed EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON because that is the terminal vocabulary for a hand decision -- EXCLUDED_KEY_COLUMN is generator-assigned and was rejected as non-terminal.
decisions.evidence: witness_map builds every comparison as `FROM w JOIN v USING (pfr_id, yr)`; yr is derived from TRY_CAST(s.season AS INT), so the column under test is the key of its own test

decisions.reason: opponent (defensive) fumble recoveries. The site publishes a BARE `FR` beside `ff` and `fr_td`, and v26 splits recoveries into fumble_recovery_opp and fumble_recovery_own, so which half it means was escalated in the O.9.3 pass as the 'whose fumble' question. It is the OPPONENT half.
decisions.evidence: MEASURED 2026-07-31 with a discriminating control. Overall fr == fumble_recovery_opp 65.95% / == own 22.93% / == opp+own 45.96%, and by era opp wins everywhere (99.0% on 2010+, 81.1% 1994-2009, 33.6% pre-1994 where our own coverage is thin). DECISIVE TEST: on the 36 player-seasons where fumble_recovery_own is NON-ZERO -- the only rows where the two readings differ at all -- fr == opp is 100.0% and fr == opp+own is 0.0%, in the 2010+ and 1994-2009 strata separately. REVERSE CONTROL: on the 787 rows where own = 0 the two hypotheses are indistinguishable and both read 98.98%, so the small base is the discriminating one BY CONSTRUCTION. THIRD LINEAGE: PFR fumbles_rec == nflcom fr on 92.62% of 2,750 player-seasons.

vocabulary_audit_capacity.law: `not a supertable column` and `cannot audit a supertable column` are DIFFERENT CLAIMS, and `disposition` only ever answered the first. A column can be rightly excluded from the SCHEMA and still be able to convict us. This field answers the second question and is ORTHOGONAL to disposition -- making it a fifth disposition value would have forced every audit-capable column out of EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON and moved counters that mean something else.

kinds.EQUATION: an identity among published columns that checks the canonicals it names
kinds.AGGREGATE: a coarser-grain value that checks a rollup of the canonicals it names
kinds.KEY: locates the row; its obligation is a crosswalk/canonicalization lane
kinds.NONE: argued to carry no audit capacity at all

statuses.RECEIPTED: measured, with a crossed control -- may be relied on
statuses.DECLARED: claimed, NOT yet measured; a queue, never a pass
statuses.BLOCKED: the route exists and the TARGET does not; `blocker` must say why

vocabulary_audit_capacity.scope_note: Applied so far only to the four Defense Career columns argued on 2026-07-31. Roughly 2,134 rows carry an exclusion reason and an unknown number of them can still audit us; the counter reports the DECLARED ones so the queue is visible rather than assumed empty.
